title: FISGA Spaces
subtitle: A modular identity for a Porto creative hub that refuses to stand still.
intro: Fisga is a multidisciplinary creative hub in central Porto — coworking, event venue, office space, and cultural glue all at once. Ahead of announcing a new multi-story space, they needed to refresh their brand to clearly communicate their value and be flexible enough to stretch across locations, formats, and audiences without losing coherence.
challenge: There was no existing brand, just a bunch of on-the-fly communication assets created by various team members over the previous two years since the start of the project. With offerings so diverse across two completely different locations — desk spaces, art exhibitions, film nights, summer jams, corporate workshops, and community programming — the brand also needed to be flexible. One visual system needed to hold all of it without feeling like a compromise in any direction.
approach: A modular system was built around an open, reconfigurable geometric mark symbolising a three-dimensional letter "F", providing a form that can uniquely adapt to create distinct marks for each current and future location. These were accompanied by their own primary colour inspired by the character of the space — Warehouse in electric blue and Garden in sunny yellow. The web design, developed in partnership with Unset Studio, extended the brand into a full digital platform, with custom booking system and event calendar.
outcome: The identity launched alongside the new space and has continued to evolve with the organisation, extending into wayfinding, signage, merchandise and social content without strain. The new branding, and the community it attracted, have helped Fisga become a member of the European Creative Hubs Network and establish itself as one of Porto's most recognisable and celebrated creative spaces.
